AppliesSpec.description: AppliesSpec is used by the applies matcher.

not.description: Negate this assertion — a passing matcher fails and vice versa.

on.description: Per-assertion document selector; overrides the test-level target: for this assertion only.

equal.description: Asserts the value at path deep-equals value (int/float normalized for YAML). All tiers.

notEqual.description: Asserts the value at path is not deep-equal to value. A missing path passes. All tiers.

greaterThan.description: Asserts the numeric value at path is strictly greater than value. All tiers.

lessThan.description: Asserts the numeric value at path is strictly less than value. All tiers.

gte.description: Asserts the numeric value at path is greater than or equal to value. All tiers.

lte.description: Asserts the numeric value at path is less than or equal to value. All tiers.

contains.description: Asserts the string at path contains the substring content, or the list at path contains the item. All tiers.

notContains.description: Asserts the string/list at path does not contain content. All tiers.

startsWith.description: Asserts the string at path starts with value. All tiers.

endsWith.description: Asserts the string at path ends with value. All tiers.

matchRegex.description: Asserts the string at path matches the RE2 regular expression pattern. All tiers.

notMatchRegex.description: Asserts the string at path does not match the RE2 regular expression pattern. All tiers.

matchTemplate.description: Asserts the string at path matches a template pattern where ${VAR} placeholders match any text. All tiers.

exists.description: Asserts path is present (any value, including null). All tiers.

notExists.description: Asserts path is absent. All tiers.

isNull.description: Asserts the value at path is null. All tiers.

isNotNull.description: Asserts the value at path is not null. All tiers.

isEmpty.description: Asserts the value at path is empty (empty string, list, map, or null). All tiers.

isNotEmpty.description: Asserts the value at path is not empty. All tiers.

isKind.description: Asserts the selected document's kind field equals this value. All tiers.

isAPIVersion.description: Asserts the selected document's apiVersion field equals this value. All tiers.

hasDocuments.description: Asserts the render produced exactly this many YAML documents. All tiers.

failedTemplate.description: Asserts the render itself failed; optionally that the error matches errorPattern. All tiers.

allOf.description: Passes when every child assertion passes. Supported tiers are the intersection of the children's tiers.

anyOf.description: Passes when at least one child assertion passes. Supported tiers are the intersection of the children's tiers.

isType.description: Asserts the value at path is of type of. All tiers.

lengthEqual.description: Asserts the collection at path has exactly value elements. All tiers.

isSubset.description: Asserts the map at path contains every key/value pair in content (deep-equal per key). All tiers.

matchSnapshot.description: Asserts the document matches the stored snapshot; writes on first run or with --update-snapshots. All tiers.

matchSchema.description: Asserts the value at path validates against an inline JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) fragment. All tiers.

expr.description: CEL expression that must evaluate to true. Bindings: resources, doc, release, values, matrix, case, output (helper tests). All tiers.

applies.description: Asserts the resource is accepted by the API server (admission, schema, RBAC, immutability). Apply tiers only (test-apply api/simulated/e2e).

rejected.description: Asserts the resource is rejected by the API server, optionally matching reason/message. Apply tiers only (test-apply api/simulated/e2e).

waitFor.description: Polls until the resource reports the given status condition. Apply tiers simulated and e2e only.

becomesReady.description: Polls until the resource is Ready (readiness inferred per kind). Apply tiers simulated and e2e only.

http.description: Sends an HTTP request to a target in the cluster and asserts on the response. e2e tier only.

lookup.description: Fetches a live resource and runs nested assertions on it. Apply tiers simulated and e2e only.

logsContain.description: Asserts a pod's logs contain a substring or /regex/ within a timeout. e2e tier only.

eventEmitted.description: Asserts a Kubernetes Event with the given reason/type was emitted for the involved object. Apply tiers simulated and e2e only.

notRendered.description: Planned (not yet implemented): asserts a specific template produced no output. See DESIGN.md §8.

metricEquals.description: Planned (not yet implemented): asserts a Prometheus-format metric on a target endpoint matches an expected value. See DESIGN.md §8.

Assertion.description: Assertion is a single assertion within a test.

apiVersions.description: Additional API versions reported as available.

CapabilityInputs.description: CapabilityInputs overrides Kubernetes API capabilities visible to templates.

path.description: Path to the chart relative to the test file.

dependencies.description: How to resolve chart dependencies before rendering.

ChartSpec.description: ChartSpec optionally overrides the chart used by a suite.

nodes.description: Number of nodes to provision (where supported).

kubeconfig.description: Path to an external kubeconfig (for the kubeconfig backend).

ClusterSpec.description: ClusterSpec selects the cluster backend used by live tiers.

namespace.description: Namespace to install the dependency into.

source.description: Where the dependency comes from (helm chart, manifest, kustomize, secret, or ref).

values.description: Values to pass when installing the dependency.

waitFor.description: Conditions that must hold before the dependency is considered ready.

exports.description: Map of export names to fields on the dependency (for downstream use).

scope.description: Lifetime of the dependency: suite (default), test, or cluster.

dependsOn.description: Names of other dependencies that must be installed first.

onFail.description: What to do on failure: clean (default) or keep the partial state.

Dependency.description: Dependency declares a resource that must be installed before tests run.

helm.description: Install a Helm chart from a repo.

manifest.description: Apply a path/glob of raw Kubernetes manifests.

secret.description: Resolve and create a Kubernetes Secret.

DependencySource.description: DependencySource is the union of supported dependency source types.

involvedObject.description: Filters events by their involvedObject. Empty fields match any.

reason.description: Expected event reason (e.g. Scheduled, Pulled). Empty matches any.

type.description: Expected event type. Empty matches any.

within.description: Max time to poll for the event as a Go duration (e.g. 30s). Default 2m.

EventAssert.description: EventAssert asserts a Kubernetes Event was emitted for the involved object.

EventObjectRef.description: EventObjectRef filters events by their involvedObject.

errorPattern.description: Optional RE2 regex the render error message must match.

FailedTemplateSpec.description: FailedTemplateSpec is used by the failedTemplate matcher.

via.description: Routing mode to reach the target. Default: portforward.

target.description: The Kubernetes resource to reach (Service, Ingress, etc.).

path.description: Request path appended to the resolved target URL.

host.description: Host header to send (e.g. for ingress routing).

body.description: Request body; serialized to JSON when not a string.

timeout.description: Per-attempt timeout as a Go duration (e.g. 30s). Default 30s.

HTTPAssert.description: HTTPAssert sends an HTTP request to a cluster target and asserts on the response.

headers.description: Expected response headers; a value wrapped in /.../ is matched as a regex.

body.description: Expected response body (used by some helpers).

bodyContains.description: Substring the response body must contain.

jsonPath.description: Map of $.json.path expressions to expected values (compared as strings).

HTTPAssertBlock.description: HTTPAssertBlock is the set of response conditions an HTTP assertion checks.

interval.description: Delay between retries as a Go duration. Default 1s.

until.description: CEL expression over status/body/headers; retries until it is true.

HTTPRetries.description: HTTPRetries is the retry policy for an HTTP assertion.

HTTPTarget.description: HTTPTarget identifies the Kubernetes resource to reach (Service, Ingress, etc.).

HelmSource.description: HelmSource installs a Helm chart from a repo or local path.

set.description: Helm --set overrides (dotted key paths to scalar values).

setJson.description: Helm --set-json overrides (dotted key paths to JSON-encoded values).

setLiteral.description: Helm --set-literal overrides (dotted key paths to literal string values).

values.description: Extra values files to merge, relative to the chart root.

Inputs.description: Inputs is the set of value overrides and release/capabilities settings.

path.description: Dotted/bracketed path into the selected document or parsed helper output.

of.description: Expected type name. Whole-number floats are accepted as int.

IsTypeSpec.description: IsTypeSpec is used by the isType matcher.

nodeCount.description: Number of kwok nodes to provision.

KwokSpec.description: KwokSpec configures the kwok node simulator.

path.description: Dotted/bracketed path into the selected document or parsed helper output.

LengthEqualSpec.description: LengthEqualSpec is used by the lengthEqual matcher.

pod.description: Selects the pod(s) whose logs are scanned.

container.description: Container name to read logs from; defaults to the pod's first container.

pattern.description: Substring to find, or /regex/ when wrapped in slashes.

within.description: Max time to stream logs as a Go duration (e.g. 30s). Default 30s.

LogsAssert.description: LogsAssert asserts a pod's logs contain a pattern within a timeout.

name.description: Pod name. Use this or labelSelector.

labelSelector.description: Label selector matching one or more pods.

namespace.description: Namespace of the pod(s). Defaults to the test's per-test namespace.

LogsPodSelector.description: LogsPodSelector selects the pod(s) whose logs are scanned.

kind.description: Resource kind to fetch (e.g. Deployment, Service).

name.description: Resource name for a single get. Use this or labelSelector.

namespace.description: Namespace to look in. Defaults to the test's per-test namespace.

labelSelector.description: Label selector for a list lookup; pair with forEach to assert per item.

within.description: Max time to poll for the resource as a Go duration (e.g. 30s). Default 2m.

until.description: Path/value condition that must hold before the then assertions run.

then.description: Assertions run against the single fetched resource.

forEach.description: Assertions run against each resource matched by labelSelector.

LookupAssert.description: LookupAssert fetches a live resource and runs nested assertions on it.

path.description: Dotted/bracketed path into the selected document or parsed helper output.

schema.description: Inline JSON Schema fragment the value must satisfy.

MatchSchemaSpec.description: MatchSchemaSpec is used by the matchSchema matcher.

path.description: Optional dotted/bracketed path to snapshot; omit to snapshot the whole document/helper output.

MatchSnapshotSpec.description: MatchSnapshotSpec is used by the matchSnapshot matcher.

MetricEqualsSpec.description: MetricEqualsSpec is the spec for the metricEquals planned matcher.

template.description: Template path that should produce no output.

NotRenderedSpec.description: NotRenderedSpec is the spec for the notRendered planned matcher.

path.description: Dotted/bracketed path into the rendered document or parsed helper output. Omit in helper tests to target the whole output.

content.description: Substring, list item, or sub-map to test for, depending on the matcher.

PathContent.description: PathContent is a dotted/bracketed path plus content to look for.

path.description: Dotted/bracketed path into the rendered document or parsed helper output. Omit in helper tests to target the whole output.

PathOnly.description: PathOnly is a bare dotted/bracketed path with no comparison value.

path.description: Dotted/bracketed path into the rendered document or parsed helper output. Omit in helper tests to target the whole output.

pattern.description: RE2 regular expression (matchRegex/notMatchRegex) or template with ${VAR} placeholders (matchTemplate).

PathPattern.description: PathPattern is a dotted/bracketed path plus a pattern.

path.description: Dotted/bracketed path into the rendered document or parsed helper output. Omit in helper tests to target the whole output.

PathValue.description: PathValue is a dotted/bracketed path plus an expected value.

message.description: Regex matched against the error message.

RejectedSpec.description: RejectedSpec is used by the rejected matcher.

isInstall.description: Whether to treat this as an install.

isUpgrade.description: Whether to treat this as an upgrade.

env.description: Environment variable to source the value from.

file.description: File path to source the value from.

generate.description: Shell command that produces the value on stdout.

fallback.description: Fallback source if the primary cannot be resolved.

SecretKeySpec.description: SecretKeySpec describes how to populate a single Secret data key.

keys.description: Non-empty list of Secret data keys to populate.

SecretSource.description: SecretSource defines how to resolve and inject a K8s Secret.

timeout.description: Maximum time to allow the command to run, as a Go duration.

ShellCommand.description: ShellCommand is shared by generate: in secret sources, LifecycleHook, and script: source (M5).

documentIndex.description: Zero-based index of the document to select when multiple documents match.

expr.description: CEL expression returning bool over each document.

TargetSpec.description: TargetSpec selects which rendered document(s) the asserts apply to.

tier.description: Tiers this test applies to. Default: [template, validate].

skip.description: Skip condition — boolean or CEL expression string.

inputs.description: Value overrides and release/capabilities settings for this test.

matrix.description: Cartesian product across declared dimensions. Reserved keys 'exclude' and 'include' filter combinations.

cases.description: Explicit list of named parameter sets; no cartesian expansion.

forEach.description: When true, runs one test per rendered document instead of one test for all documents.

call.description: Named template (define block) to invoke. Mutually exclusive with target:. Activates helper test mode.

args.description: Dict passed to the named template. Values are YAML literals or ${{ CEL }} expressions.

outputAs.description:
How to interpret the helper's rendered output. Default: string.
yaml/json enable path-based matchers on the parsed structure. bool treats non-empty output as true.

target.description: Selects which rendered document(s) the asserts apply to.

setup.description: Lifecycle hooks run before this test.

teardown.description: Lifecycle hooks run after this test.

Test.description: Test is a single test case.

kind.description: Resource kind to poll (e.g. Deployment, Pod, StatefulSet).

name.description: Resource name. Provide this or labelSelector.

namespace.description: Namespace to poll in. Defaults to the test's per-test namespace.

labelSelector.description: Label selector identifying the resource(s) to poll. Provide this or name.

condition.description:
status.conditions[] type that must become True (e.g. Available, Ready).
For becomesReady this is inferred from the kind.

timeout.description: Maximum time to poll before failing, as a Go duration (e.g. 30s, 2m). Default 2m.

WaitForSpec.description: WaitForSpec polls a resource until a status condition is met.

suite.description: Human-readable name for this test file.

helpers.description:
Template files loaded for their define blocks only — no manifests are rendered.
Used for helper function tests (call:). Paths relative to chart root.

chart.description: Optional chart override for this suite.

defaults.description: Default inputs applied to every test in this suite.

dependencies.description: Resources to install before tests run.

beforeAll.description: Lifecycle hooks run once before all tests.

afterAll.description: Lifecycle hooks run once after all tests.

tests.description: The list of test cases in this suite.
